issue.title: [TRACKER] FBX Importer bugs that depend on Assimp.

repository.name: godot
repository.description: Godot Engine – Multi-platform 2D and 3D game engine

issue.body:
This is the list of issues on Assimp's side that we are pending on in order to have proper FBX import in Godot. We are tracking them in one of our issues in order to be on the same page.

- [x] https://github.com/assimp/assimp/issues/2474 - Assimp removes bones not linked to vertices. Godot needs those bones. There was an option added to Assimp to not remove them but it seems broken.
- [ ] https://github.com/assimp/assimp/issues/2498 Assimp preserves FBX pivots and hands them over to us. We don't want them and believe Assimp should collapse them into regular transforms. There was an option added to do this on their side, but it seems broken.
- [x] https://github.com/assimp/assimp/issues/2561 CM to M conversion seems incomplete in Assimp: Not everything is properly converted, resulting in broken files. It also seems that axis conversion does not apply to  those either (needs to be verified).

Will add more as we find them. Feel free to test FBX import in Godot and help us open issues in Assimp to aid their developers in improving the format support.
